home.hero_subtitle: Associate Professor of Psychology | Licensed Psychologist | School Psychology Expert
home.hero_body: Over two decades of experience strengthening educator capacity and improving student outcomes through evidence-based, data-informed practices.
home.about_body: Dr. Stacy A.S. Williams is an Associate Professor of Psychology at Marist University, a licensed psychologist, and a certified school psychologist. She is a nationally recognized expert in school psychology, Multi-Tiered Systems of Supports (MTSS), and Response to Intervention (RTI).
home.contact_cta_body: Interested in consulting, research collaboration, or professional development? Reach out.

teaching.intro: Effective teaching requires deep knowledge, strong organization, clear communication, genuine enthusiasm, rapport with students, and fair evaluation. Dr. Williams is committed to creating inclusive classrooms that develop the whole learner, academically, socially, and personally.
teaching.philosophy_body: Dr. Williams' approach to teaching is guided by research-based practices and informed by scholarship on the identity negotiations of women of color in academia, examining how race, gender, class, and culture intersect in educational spaces.

scholarship.intro: Dr. Williams centers her scholarly work at the intersection of training, teaching, and applied consultation, promoting student success, well-being, and sustainable systems-level improvement.

consulting.intro: Dr. Williams provides professional development and consulting services to school districts, universities, and educational organizations. Her work emphasizes diversity, equity, and inclusion frameworks alongside evidence-based instructional practices.

service.intro: Dr. Williams is committed to serving the broader school psychology community through leadership roles in national and regional professional organizations.
service.quote: We can always choose, in every moment of our life, between the way of selfishness and that of love.

photography.intro: Photography is both a creative outlet and a form of self-care for Dr. Williams. Her collection spans water, beaches, flowers, nature, people, and architecture, including recent AI-enhanced artwork using generative tools.
photography.ai_note: Some works are AI-enhanced reimaginings of original photographs.

poems.intro: "I write from emotion. When anger burns or sadness lingers, my pen becomes my release." These collections explore conflict, love, resilience, and celebration.
